form.twoFactorHelp: Where can I get the 2FA code?

keycloak.title: Sign in with Keycloak
keycloak.description: Use SSO to authenticate in Keycloak, then the system exchanges it into an internal session for gateway and downstream services.
keycloak.bullet2: No need to re-enter internal password.
keycloak.bullet3: Final token is still stored consistently.

twoFactorModal.title: How to get 2FA code
twoFactorModal.description: The 2FA code is not generated on the login screen. You must enable 2FA first in 2FA Setup after signing in.
twoFactorModal.step2: Open 2FA Setup menu or go to /2fa-setup.
twoFactorModal.step3: Scan QR with Google Authenticator or a compatible OTP app.
twoFactorModal.step4: The app generates a new 6-digit code every 30 seconds.
twoFactorModal.step5: When OTP is required later, enter that 6-digit code in login form.
twoFactorModal.info: If your account has not enabled 2FA, OTP is not required.
